_comment: Stage 3 beta-only oracle template (30M shakeout scale). One file per arm x seed at launch time: set arm.name/gate_mode/rank/basis_dir and seed. Arms per PLAN.md: O0 none, O1 scalar_delta, O2-O5 spectral r1/r2/r4/r8 (basis_signed_credit), O6 basis_elementwise_credit_second_moment r4, O7 basis_reciprocal_activation r4, O8 basis_gradient_covariance r4, O9 basis_qk_asymmetry r4, O10 basis_random r4, O11 coordinate_diag, O12 standard_extra_lowrank r4. Bases come from the audit output directory; never from validation data.
